name: tr_slowmo
caption:
IF KYLE ANDERSON WAS A POKÉMON TRAINER, THIS IS HIS TEAM 🎮🏀

🐌 Slowpoke, Slow-Mo: his nickname since 8th grade, for his deliberate pace
🪄 Alakazam, the magician: his high school coach called him a modern-day Magic Johnson
🐉 Hydreigon, the triple threat: 13 points, 12 rebounds, 11 assists in one UCLA game
🐱 Meowth, the pickpocket: 6 steals in one playoff game, a Memphis record
🌊 Lapras, the traveler: 7 franchises counting us, plus China at the 2023 World Cup
👑 Slowking, the ace: a 6-9 point guard with a 7-3 wingspan, now ours

Which one would you add? 👇

facts.claim: Anderson nicknamed Slow Mo after his deliberate style, a nickname earned in eighth (8th) grade in AAU; high school coach Bob Hurley: 'I think he's a modern-day Magic Johnson'; November 22, 2013 at UCLA: 13 points, 12 rebounds, 11 assists (triple-double) vs Morehead State; 2021 playoff opener at Utah: Memphis franchise single-game playoff record six (6) steals; franchises: Spurs, Grizzlies, Timberwolves, Warriors, Heat, Jazz, Raptors (7); Chinese citizenship, played for China at the 2023 FIBA World Cup; standing 6 feet 9 inches (6-9) with a 7 feet 3 inches (7-3) wingspan, ran the offense as point guard; 2014 NBA draft 30th overall pick (#30)
